raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Follow-up to #27546.

When a disaggregated prefill/decode router (`sgl-model-gateway`, `sgl-router`, or `MiniLoadBalancer`) dispatches a DP-aware PD request (`prefill_worker.dp_rank() == Some(rank)`), it injects `"disagg_prefill_dp_rank": rank` into the **decode** request body so decode can connect directly to the selected prefill DP rank without querying `/query_dp_rank`, while omitting `"disagg_prefill_dp_rank"` from the **prefill** request body (sending only `data_parallel_rank` / `routed_dp_rank`).

On the prefill engine (`load_balance_method="follow_bootstrap_room"` by default):
1. `DataParallelController.follow_bootstrap_room_scheduler` honors `req.routed_dp_rank` and dispatches the request to the router-selected `dp_rank`.
2. `PrefillBootstrapQueue.create_sender` constructs `CommonKVSender` with `req_has_disagg_prefill_dp_rank = req.disagg_prefill_dp_rank is not None` (`False`).
3. Unless `bootstrap_room % num_dp_ranks` happens to match the selected rank or `SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_FORCE_QUERY_PREFILL_DP_RANK=1` is set (which still triggers a redundant blocking `/register_dp_rank` HTTP POST per request even though decode already received `disagg_prefill_dp_rank`), `CommonKVSender.__init__` aborts `(num_dp_ranks - 1) / num_dp_ranks` of requests with `KVPoll.Failed` (`follow_bootstrap_room conflict`).

## Modifications

- **`sgl-model-gateway/src/routers/http/pd_router.rs` & `sgl-model-gateway/tests/routing/pd_routing_test.rs`**: Generalize `inject_prefill_dp_rank_for_decode` to `inject_prefill_dp_rank` and inject `"disagg_prefill_dp_rank"` on both prefill and decode PD worker requests when `prefill.dp_rank()` is `Some(rank)` (leaving non-DP workers zero-copy `Cow::Borrowed` without `disagg_prefill_dp_rank`).
- **`sgl-router/src/server/routes/chat/forward.rs`, `sgl-router/tests/proxy/dp_rank_routing.rs`, & `sgl-router/REFERENCE.md`**: Pass `prefill_rank` into `Leg::new` on the PD prefill leg (`pd.is_some()`) as well as decode, while keeping plain non-PD requests and fan-out PD requests (`prefill_rank == None`) unchanged.
- **`sgl-model-gateway/bindings/python/src/sglang_router/mini_lb.py`**: Set `prefill_req["disagg_prefill_dp_rank"] = p_rank` alongside `decode_req["disagg_prefill_dp_rank"] = p_rank` in `_fork_dp_requests`.
- **`python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/{base/conn.py,fake/conn.py,common/conn.py,prefill.py}` & `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_register_to_bootstrap.py`**: Forward `req_disagg_prefill_dp_rank=req.disagg_prefill_dp_rank` to `KVSender` (preserving the `req_has_disagg_prefill_dp_rank` keyword argument), resolve the dispatched DP rank across both `--enable-dp-attention` (`attn_dp_rank`) and replica DP (`system_dp_rank`), skip both `follow_bootstrap_room conflict` and `/register_dp_rank` when `req_disagg_prefill_dp_rank` matches, and fail fast with `disagg_prefill_dp_rank mismatch` if an explicit `disagg_prefill_dp_rank` ever disagrees with the dispatched rank.

## Accuracy Tests

 Pure routing / KV bootstrap handshake fix; no kernel or model forward changes. Verified via:
- `cargo test --manifest-path sgl-model-gateway/Cargo.toml --lib routers::http::pd_router::tests` (9/9 passed)
- `cargo test --manifest-path sgl-model-gateway/Cargo.toml --test routing_tests pd_routing_test` (10/10 passed)
- `cargo test --manifest-path sgl-router/Cargo.toml --test proxy dp_rank_routing` (11/11 passed)
- `python test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_register_to_bootstrap.py -v` (8/8 passed)

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Eliminates the per-request synchronous HTTP POST to `/register_dp_rank` on prefill when DP-aware PD routing is enabled without requiring `SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_FORCE_QUERY_PREFILL_DP_RANK=1`.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Follow-up to #27546: DP-aware PD routers (`sgl-model-gateway`, `sgl-router`, and `mini_lb.py`) injected `disagg_prefill_dp_rank` on the decode leg only, leaving `req.disagg_prefill_dp_rank` unset on prefill so `CommonKVSender.__init__` aborted `(num_dp_ranks - 1) / num_dp_ranks` of requests with `follow_bootstrap_room conflict` unless `SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_FORCE_QUERY_PREFILL_DP_RANK=1` was set. This PR forwards `disagg_prefill_dp_rank` on both PD legs and validates rank consistency in `CommonKVSender.__init__`.

Tests: `sgl-model-gateway/tests/routing/pd_routing_test.rs`, `sgl-router/tests/proxy/dp_rank_routing.rs`, and `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_register_to_bootstrap.py`.

+        from sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.conn import CommonKVSender
+
+        override = get_context().override_server_args(
+            load_balance_method="follow_bootstrap_room",
+            dp_size=1,
+            attn_dp_size=4,
+            enable_dp_attention=True,
+        )
+        override.install()
+        self.addCleanup(override.restore)
+
+        mgr = self._make_sender_mgr(attn_dp_rank=2)
+        with envs.SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_FORCE_QUERY_PREFILL_DP_RANK.override(False):
+            sender = CommonKVSender(
+                mgr=mgr,
+                bootstrap_addr="127.0.0.1:8998",
+                bootstrap_room=12,
+                req_has_disagg_prefill_dp_rank=False,
+                req_disagg_prefill_dp_rank=None,
+            )
+
+        self.assertEqual(sender.conclude_state, KVPoll.Failed)
+        self.assertEqual(mgr.request_status[12], KVPoll.Failed)
+        mgr.record_failure.assert_called_once()
+        self.assertIn(
+            "follow_bootstrap_room conflict", mgr.record_failure.call_args[0][1]
+        )
+        mock_post.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_prefill_bootstrap_queue_create_sender_passes_disagg_prefill_dp_rank(self):
+        from sglang.srt.disaggregation.prefill import PrefillBootstrapQueue
+        from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import TransferBackend
+
+        pm = MagicMock(spec=PrefillBootstrapQueue)
+        pm._check_if_req_exceed_kv_capacity.return_value = False
+        pm.transfer_backend = TransferBackend.NIXL
+        pm.kv_manager = MagicMock()
+        pm.bootstrap_port = 8998
+
+        req = MagicMock()
+        req.bootstrap_host = "127.0.0.1"
+        req.bootstrap_room = 99
+        req.disagg_prefill_dp_rank = 3
+
+        fake_sender_cls = MagicMock()
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.srt.disaggregation.prefill.get_kv_class",
+            return_value=fake_sender_cls,
+        ):
+            ok = PrefillBootstrapQueue.create_sender(pm, req, num_kv_heads=8)
+
+        self.assertTrue(ok)
+        fake_sender_cls.assert_called_once_with(
+            mgr=pm.kv_manager,
+            bootstrap_addr="127.0.0.1:8998",
+            bootstrap_room=99,
+            req_has_disagg_prefill_dp_rank=True,
+            req_disagg_prefill_dp_rank=3,
+        )
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()

Could a maintainer add `run-ci` and review? Every test job was skipped; the red checks are `pr-gate` and the `*-finish` jobs that wait on it.

Follow-up to #27546: DP-aware PD routers (`sgl-model-gateway`, `sgl-router`, and `mini_lb.py`) injected `disagg_prefill_dp_rank` on the decode leg only, leaving `req.disagg_prefill_dp_rank` unset on prefill so `CommonKVSender.__init__` aborted `(num_dp_ranks - 1) / num_dp_ranks` of requests with `follow_bootstrap_room conflict` unless `SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_FORCE_QUERY_PREFILL_DP_RANK=1` was set. This PR forwards `disagg_prefill_dp_rank` on both PD legs and validates rank consistency in `CommonKVSender.__init__`.

Tests: `sgl-model-gateway/tests/routing/pd_routing_test.rs`, `sgl-router/tests/proxy/dp_rank_routing.rs`, and `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_register_to_bootstrap.py`.
